note: Video formats the office can build. The idea-scout adds and refreshes these from YouTube and Instagram; the clip-editor offers them as options and builds the one the owner picks. 'recipe' is the exact tool call. 'needs' lists anything our tools cannot do yet. "buildable" is true when the recipe works with the tools as they are; the page lists only those as styles. Second run (deep): numbers come from tools/yt.py, saved in work/research/ideas/results.jsonl. top_examples are the three best-viewed matches; 'views' are all-time views, Shorts shelf items give no date or channel. make_first_rank (1 = first) is set on the ten formats Aarav should make first, see work/research/ideas/summary.md.
